description: Rows of a table {columns, labels, rows, total_rows, truncated}: FCS events ($PnN columns), plate reads (well, row, col, read, wavelength_nm, time_s, value), event, spike or peak tables (including the vendor's own integration results). Values are raw; FCS can be compensated, transformed and given 0/1 population columns from a workspace or Gating-ML file. filter with count=true counts the events meeting conditions.

compensate.description: FCS only: compensate the values: `auto` (the gating file's matrix when one is given, else the file's $SPILLOVER/$SPILL/SPILL), `fcs` or `gating`. Values become FCS scale values first ($PnE, $PnG, $TIMESTEP).

count.description: Return only the count (`filter.matched_rows`, `total_rows`, `percent`), no rows.

filter.description: Row conditions `COLUMN OP NUMBER` (OP: > >= < <= == !=; COLUMN: $PnN, $PnS or `gate:<path>`), all of which must hold, e.g. `["FITC-A > 1000"]`. Tested on the values returned (after compensate/transform when given) over the whole table; `filter.matched_rows` counts every match and first_row/max_rows page through them.

gatingml.description: FCS only: Gating-ML 2.0 file (same uses as workspace).

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to return. Default 100 (fewer for wide tables: about 5000 values), capped at 10000.

parameters.description: FCS only: parameters ($PnN) to transform; default every fluorescence parameter.

populations.description: FCS only: populations (paths like `/Lymphocytes/Singlets` or unique names) whose 0/1 membership is appended as `gate:<path>` columns.

sample.description: Workspace sample name or id (default: matched by file name or $FIL).

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

table.description: Table index (FCS data set or plate read; see openreadout_info → tables[]). Default 0.

transform.description: FCS only: transform after compensation: `logicle`, `arcsinh`, `hyperlog`, `log`, `linear`, `biex`, `flowjo-log`, `arcsinh-cofactor`, with parameters as `NAME:K=V,…` (`logicle:T=262144,W=0.5,M=4.5,A=0`, `arcsinh-cofactor:5`), or `workspace` for the FlowJo sample's per-parameter transforms.

workspace.description: FCS only: FlowJo workspace (.wsp) for compensate=gating, transform=workspace and populations.

name: openreadout_table

AppliedTransform.description: A transform applied to one table column.

fluorochromes.description: Rows: fluorochromes, or the detectors that receive the unmixed values.

name.description: Matrix name or id; `$SPILLOVER`/`$SPILL`/`SPILL` for the FCS file's own.

spectral.description: More detectors than rows: unmixed by ordinary least squares.

used.description: Whether a gate (or the table) used it.

gating_file.description: Path of the workspace or Gating-ML file that defines the population.

TableFilterSummary.description: Rows of a whole table that meet every condition (`table --where`, `--count`).

conditions.description:
The conditions as parsed (`FITC-A > 1000`), all of which a row must meet. Empty with
`--count` alone (every row counts).

matched_rows.description: Rows of the whole table that meet every condition (not only the returned page).

values.description:
The values the conditions were tested on: `raw` (as stored) or `processed` (FCS scale
values after compensation/transforms; see `processing`).

TableProcessing.description: What `table` did to the raw values before returning them.

gates.description: Membership columns appended (1 = in the population, 0 = not).

scale.description:
Channel-to-scale conversions applied (`$PnE`, `$PnG`, `$TIMESTEP`); every processed table
starts from scale values.

filter.description:
Present with `--where`/`--count`: the row conditions and how many rows of the whole
table meet them. `rows`, `first_row` and `truncated` then page through the matching rows.

first_row.description: Zero-based index of the first row returned.

format.description: Format id of the input file.

processing.description:
Present when the values were processed (FCS scale values, compensation, transforms,
population membership columns); absent for raw values.

rows.description:
Row-major values; `rows[r][c]`. Non-finite values serialize as `null`. A text column
holds codes here; `texts` has its text.

texts.description:
Text columns (`info` → `tables[].columns[].extra.categories`) by column name: the text
of each returned row, so `texts[name][r]` is what `rows[r][c]` codes. Absent when the
table has no text column.

truncated.description: True when more rows follow the returned slice.
